question: If y = sqrt[3]{6} - 4, then what is the value of y³ + 12y² + 48y + 100?
solution:
Given:

y = sqrt[3]{6} - 4

Concept used:

(A + B)³ = A³ + 3A²B + 3AB² + B³

Calculation:

y = sqrt[3]{6} - 4

⇒ y + 4 = sqrt[3]{6}

⇒ (y + 4)³ = 6

⇒ y³ + 12y² + 48y + 64 = 6

⇒ y3 + 12y2 + 48y + 64 + 36 = 6 + 36

⇒ y3 + 12y2 + 48y + 64 + 36 = 42

**∴ The value of y3 + 12y2 + 48y + 64 + 36 is 42.**
